Czym jest „plaster” i jak łączą się częś: What is a grid panel, and how do the parts of the house connect?
Plaster to siatka krzyżujących się belek: A grid panel consists of crossing ribs, each made from a pair of boards. Placed horizontally, it forms a floor or ceiling; vertically, it forms a wall. End boards connect the panels: the side shortened by 24 cm rests on a full rib of the adjacent panel, while the longer side runs alongside it. This forms the wall-to-floor joint.

Belkę składamy z dwóch warstw desek. Prz: A beam is made from two layers of boards. One layer is offset along the other, so the end of one board sits beside an unbroken section of its neighbour. Add more boards to extend the beam.
Wsuwamy belki w siebie pod kątem 90°. Wp: Slide the beams together at 90°. Each slot reaches halfway through the beam height, so the joint stays within the height of one beam. This creates a grid panel of ribs and open cells.
Plastry układamy poziomo jako podłogę i: Grid panels form floors and ceilings when laid horizontally, and walls when placed vertically. The roof uses the same grid. Adjacent panels connect through slots and stepped board ends.
Do komór podłogi, ścian zewnętrznych i d: Fitted insulation blocks go into the cells of the floor, external walls and roof. Membranes, linings and finishes follow. The facade covers the structure shown in this model.

Materiały, bezpieczeństwo, formalności i: Materials, safety, approvals and financing. Answers to questions before you build.
Czy dom z OSB lub sklejki jest bezpieczn: What about fire safety in an OSB or plywood house?
OSB i sklejka są materiałami palnymi. Be: OSB and plywood are combustible materials. Fire safety depends on the complete design: structure, protective linings, insulation, joints and service penetrations. A fire-resistance rating applies to a specific assembly, not to a board alone. The layers must meet the project requirements; we do not assign one REI rating to every Combstruct configuration.
OSB/3 jest przeznaczone do zastosowań no: OSB/3 is intended for load-bearing use in humid conditions, which does not mean it can withstand continuous soaking. The structure needs protection during storage and assembly. In the completed home, correctly designed wall and roof layers, sealed details and ventilation manage moisture. Plywood must also be specified for its intended exposure conditions.
Jak trwały jest taki dom?: How long will the house last?
O trwałości decydują projekt, jakość mat: Durability depends on the design, material and assembly quality, and maintenance. Preventing prolonged moisture exposure is essential. The roof, facade, flashings and services need periodic inspection. The board type alone cannot establish a guaranteed lifespan for the whole house.
Przed zamówieniem sprawdź pisemne warunk: Before ordering, check the written terms for your selected scope: materials, assembly and finishing. They should identify the guarantor, coverage period, defect reporting procedure and maintenance obligations. Any supplier warranty is separate from statutory customer rights. Ask us about the terms for your chosen option.
W Polsce wybór procedury zależy od budyn: In Poland, the procedure depends on the building, plot and impact area, rather than whether the structure uses boards or masonry. Some detached single-family homes qualify for a notification procedure; others require a building permit. The design must comply with the local plan or planning decision. The appropriate route is determined for each project. Outside Poland, local rules apply.
Czy bank sfinansuje budowę kredytem hipo: Can a mortgage finance the build?
Finansowanie trzeba potwierdzić z wybran: Confirm financing with your chosen lender before ordering. The lender assesses the borrower, property, project documentation and loan security. Present the design, cost estimate and payment schedule, particularly if the material kit is paid for before assembly. We do not claim automatic acceptance of Combstruct by every bank.
Czy system ma patent i certyfikaty?: Does the system have a patent and certificates?
Belka grzebieniowa, element konstrukcyjn: The comb beam, structural element and load-bearing core are described in international patent application WO 2025/264131 A1. Publication of an application is not a technical certificate for a building. Material performance declarations, structural calculations and assembly classifications apply to specific products and designs and must be checked for the selected project.
The comb beam, a structural element using it and the load-bearing core of a building are the subject of an international patent application by Combstruct.

A1 oznacza publikację zgłoszenia. Zgłosz: A1 identifies an application publication. A patent application does not replace testing, calculations or the technical documentation for a specific building.
